## Code Review

This pull request introduces a helper function `_tool_call_key` to support streaming tool calls from OpenAI-compatible endpoints (such as Gemini) that omit the `index` field, along with corresponding unit tests. A review comment correctly identifies a bug in `_tool_call_key` where interleaved parallel tool calls with repeated IDs could be misrouted, and provides a code suggestion to search across all accumulated tool calls to resolve the issue.
